diagrams.title: From intent to an observable system
diagrams.summary: Core provides the contracts that move a declared intent toward a manipulable state without executing or displaying the resulting system.

nodes.label: Intent
nodes.description: Meaning and expected effects are named.

nodes.label: Manifest
nodes.description: The application, its capabilities, and its contracts are declared.

nodes.label: Projection
nodes.description: A surface can finally make it perceptible.

diagrams.caption: Core defines the building blocks and their boundaries; runtimes and interfaces remain separate consumers.
